description: This Java source file defines the EntityCacheServices class, which provides cache management services for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework, including cache clearing and distributed cache invalidation methods.

classes.name: EntityCacheServices
classes.description: Provides cache management services for entity caching, including cache clearing and distributed cache invalidation, implementing the DistributedCacheClear interface.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Initializes the delegator, dispatcher, and userLoginId for cache operations.

methods.name: getAuthUserLogin
methods.description: Retrieves the authenticated user login information from the database.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line for a specific value in a distributed environment.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line for a given primary key entity in a distributed environment.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache lines matching a specific condition in a distributed environment.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line for a primary key in a distributed environment.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all entity caches, optionally in a distributed manner.

methods.name: clearAllEntityCaches
methods.description: Service method to clear all entity caches, with optional distribution.

methods.name: clearCacheLine
methods.description: Service method to clear a specific cache line based on provided context (value, dummyPK, primaryKey, or condition).
